definitions.explanation: Paying careful attention to details and doing things properly.
Being careful about time and commitments.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{几帳面|きちょうめん}な{性格|せいかく}で、{部屋|へや}はいつも{整理整頓|せいりせいとん}されている。
examples.english: She has a meticulous personality, and her room is always tidy.

examples.japanese: {几帳面|きちょうめん}に{記録|きろく}をつけている。
{日本人|にほんじん}は{几帳面|きちょうめん}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Japanese people are said to be punctual and precise.

examples.japanese: {几帳面|きちょうめん}な{字|じ}で{書|か}かれた{手紙|てがみ}をもらった。
examples.english: I received a letter written in neat handwriting.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{几帳面|きちょうめん}に{毎月|まいつき}の{支出|ししゅつ}を{記録|きろく}している。
examples.english: He meticulously records his monthly expenses.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{几帳面|きちょうめん}で、{約束|やくそく}の{時間|じかん}に{遅|おく}れたことがない。
examples.english: He's so punctual that he has never been late for an appointment.

notes:
FORMS:
・{几帳面|きちょうめん}な + noun (adnominal)
・{几帳面|きちょうめん}に (adverbial)
・{几帳面|きちょうめん}だ (predicative)

ETYMOLOGY:
From {几帳|きちょう} (a type of curtain stand used in traditional Japanese rooms) + {面|めん} (surface). The ornate edges of these stands required precise craftsmanship.

USAGE:
Positive connotation when describing reliability:
・{几帳面|きちょうめん}な{仕事|しごと}ぶり (meticulous work style)
・{几帳面|きちょうめん}に{支払|しはら}う (to pay on time)
・{几帳面|きちょうめん}に{管理|かんり}する (to manage carefully)

ANTONYM:
・{大雑把|おおざっぱ} - rough, sloppy
